answer: Each voting agent locks a bond before it can attest anything. Audits draw random peers to recheck its work, and a fabricated result forfeits the whole bond to the auditors. Spawning a thousand fake agents is free, but funding a thousand bonds is not, so a sybil swarm trying to cross this canyon goes broke. Honest nodes atop the mesa keep their stakes, and the fable of cheap identities ends at the first failed audit.
